COMSOL_electron_impact_lookup_native.note: COMSOL 6.4 Electron Impact Reaction lookup-table Rate coefficients use mean electron energy versus m^3/s.

COMSOL_molar_reaction_expression.note: COMSOL examples convert particle electron-impact coefficients to the molar reaction-expression basis with N_A_const.

project_resolution_for_user_supplied_tab.provenance_class: project unit resolution inferred from coefficient magnitude plus COMSOL/QPX dimensional conventions; uploaded files themselves contain no explicit unit metadata
project_resolution_for_user_supplied_tab.activation_policy: production may use k_raw directly only in a molar-concentration expression; a particle-number-density expression must divide k_raw by N_A first

sanity_ranges.expected_particle_electron_neutral_rate_: roughly 1e-16 to 1e-12 over the supplied mean-energy range depending on channel

forbidden_interpretation: Do not interpret the supplied 1e7-1e11 raw coefficients directly as m^3/s.
